decoys.RCL_fixed_rate_fair_value: The $701 million sensitivity is fixed-rate debt fair value, not interest expense on floating-rate debt.
decoys.STZ_fixed_rate_fair_value: The $533.7 million table value is fixed-rate debt fair-value sensitivity; use the $5.3 million interest-expense impact and the $806.7 million short-term borrowing amount instead.
decoys.SJM_financial_liability_fair_value: The $607.2 million value is long-term debt fair-value sensitivity from a rate decrease, not interest expense sensitivity.
decoys.GIS_pension_discount_rate: The $29 million value is benefit-plan expense sensitivity from discount rates, not debt interest expense.
decoys.CL_implied_debt: Do not infer CL's debt from $3 million / 1%; use the separately stated $936 million commercial paper amount.
decoys.PWR_commercial_paper_average: PWR's average daily commercial paper amount is not fiscal-year-end variable-rate debt outstanding.
